name: Bylo
tagline: HOA software that doesn't make you want to move.
positioning: Bylo runs dues, violations, and board votes for property management enterprises managing thousands of communities — without the fax machine energy.

hero.h1: Every HOA runs on spite. Yours can run on Bylo.
hero.sub: Dues, violations, architectural requests, and board votes across every community you manage — in one place your regional managers won't secretly resent. Enterprise-ready, audit-friendly.

features.title: Dues that collect themselves
features.description: Automated assessments, late fees, and lien-ready ledgers across thousands of units. Owners pay online; your AR team stops chasing checks that were 'definitely in the mail.'

features.title: Violation workflows, minus the drama
features.description: Photo-logged notices, escalation timelines, and a full paper trail for the one homeowner who lawyers up over a garden gnome.

features.title: Board votes with a real quorum
features.description: Digital ballots, proxy tracking, and meeting minutes that generate themselves. No more 'was that motion carried?' three weeks later.

features.title: Architectural requests, tracked
features.description: Homeowners submit ARC applications with plans attached. Committees approve or deny with reasons on record. Fewer surprise pergolas.

features.title: Portfolio-wide reporting
features.description: Roll up delinquency, reserve health, and violation volume across every community for the board deck your CFO actually reads.

features.title: Audit trail that holds up
features.description: Every fee, vote, and notice timestamped and immutable. Built for the enterprises whose lawyers ask 'can you prove that?'

testimonials.quote: We migrated 1,400 communities onto Bylo in a quarter. Delinquency reporting that took my team nine days now takes about four minutes. I no longer dread the board meetings.
testimonials.name: Danielle Voss

testimonials.quote: Our old system was three spreadsheets and a prayer. Bylo's violation trail has already saved us in two arbitration cases. It pays for itself in avoided drama.
testimonials.name: Marcus Referred — Okonkwo

testimonials.quote: The usage-based pricing means we're not paying for units we offboard. My finance team stopped emailing me about the contract, which is the highest praise I can offer.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For growing management firms consolidating their first few thousand doors.
For regional and national firms managing large, messy portfolios.
For the largest operators with compliance teams and lawyers on speed dial.

homepage.footerBlurb: Bylo is HOA management software for enterprises that manage communities, not chaos. Built for the people who read the bylaws so nobody else has to.
